claims.body: The Maple Leafs’ penalty kill is one of the league’s worst, and the Rangers’ power play is near the top. Discipline matters more than usual for the Maple Leafs tonight.

claims.head: The Rangers hound the puck, the Maple Leafs sit back
claims.body: On forecheck pressure, the Rangers are one of the league’s best, but Toronto is one of the worst. They’re about as far apart as two teams get. Expect the Rangers to win more pucks back deep in the Maple Leafs’ end.

notes.text: Spencer Martin was added to the roster on Oct 14.
Justin Dowling was added to the roster on Oct 15 and has played beside Oliver Bjorkstrand and Jaroslav Chmelař.
Sean Durzi has started killing penalties: on the ice for 43% of the team’s shorthanded time in 9 games, up from 7% with his old team last season.
Chris Tanev is out week to week (upper body injury) and has missed the last 2 games. He is one of their most valuable skaters. Darren Raddysh has taken his spot beside Jake McCabe.
John Tavares is out week to week (lower body injury), reported after he played in their last game. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Marshall Rifai was added to the roster on Oct 12.

TOR.head: A tough matchup for the Maple Leafs
TOR.body: Even though Toronto has home-ice advantage, the Rangers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, and the Maple Leafs will be without Tavares. The Maple Leafs can pull it off if their power play gets going.

NYR.head: Advantage, the Rangers
NYR.body: Even though Toronto has home-ice advantage, the Rangers have been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately, and the Maple Leafs will be without Tavares. The Maple Leafs can make it interesting if their power play gets going.
